results.title: Padres hand Marlins 11th straight loss in 7-2 victory
results.description: The San Diego Padres accomplished a feat they hadn't achieved in nearly six weeks: winning a series away from Petco Park. Saturday afternoon's 7-2 victory over the Miami Marlins at LoanDepot Park finally changed that.

Super Falcons arrives in Rabat for 2026 WAFCON
results.description: Ten-time African champions, the Super Falcons of Nigeria, have arrived in Rabat ahead of the 2026 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON), where they will play all their Group C matches in Morocco’s capital, BSNSports.com.ng reports. The post Super Falcons arrives in Rabat for 2026 WAFCON appeared first on The Sun Nigeria .
